settlement.schema_instruction: Place receiving_order inside decisions, not as a top-level sibling. Use exactly ['Alpha', 'Bravo', 'Charlie'] for receiving_order, with no shipment descriptions or time ranges appended. Keep dock-time fields as time-range strings; record cold-chain and sanitation details in commitments.

commitments.detail: Post-receipt sanitization of all Bravo clinic consumables is mandatory.
